more.title: Items, shops and settings
more.itemsHint: Names, units, HSN and GST rate
more.shopsHint: Customer shops and their GST details
more.settingsHint: RK name, GSTIN, bank details, invoice prefix

rates.title: Today's rates
rates.missing_one: 1 item has no rate. Shops cannot order it today.
rates.missing_other: {{count}} items have no rate. Shops cannot order them today.
rates.invalid: Some rates are not valid. Use numbers like 1350 or 46.50.
rates.noItems: There are no active items yet. Add items first.

items.title: Items
items.unitHint: How it is sold: bag, kg, can…
items.offNote: This item is switched off. Shops cannot order it. Old bills keep it.

shops.title: Shops
shops.gstinHint: Leave empty if the shop has no GSTIN.

users.title: Logins
users.name: Name
users.phoneHint: The person signs in with this number.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Tell the person in private.
users.switchWarn: A switched-off login cannot sign in and sees nothing.
users.cannotSelf: You cannot switch off your own login.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.bankHint: Shown on the bill if you fill it in.
settings.prefixHint: 1 to 6 letters or digits. Bills look like RK/2627/0042.
settings.includeGstHint: Leave off if rates are before GST and tax is added on the bill.

errors.hsn: HSN code must be 4 to 8 digits.
errors.gstRate: Choose a GST rate from the list.
errors.stateCode: Enter a 2-digit state code, for example 33.
errors.shopRequired: Choose the shop for this shop owner.
errors.prefix: Use 1 to 6 capital letters or digits.

apiErrors.duplicate_phone: That mobile number already has a login.
apiErrors.invalid: Some details are not valid. Please check and try again.
apiErrors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
apiErrors.network: No internet connection. Please try again.
apiErrors.not_configured: The app is not set up yet.
apiErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
apiErrors.shop_inactive: Your shop is switched off. Please contact RK.
apiErrors.bad_quantity: Quantities must be more than 0, with at most 3 decimals.
apiErrors.inactive_item: An item is no longer sold. Please check your cart.
apiErrors.no_rate: An item has no rate today. Please check your cart.
apiErrors.not_placed: This order already has a bill, or was cancelled. Please refresh.
apiErrors.already_delivered: This order is delivered, so its bill cannot be cancelled.
apiErrors.has_payments: A payment is recorded against this bill, so it cannot be cancelled.
apiErrors.reason_required: Please write the reason (at least 3 letters).
apiErrors.not_in_order: That item is not in this order.
apiErrors.not_allowed: You are not allowed to do this.
apiErrors.not_billed: This order has no bill yet.
apiErrors.bad_amount: Enter an amount above 0, with at most 2 decimals.
apiErrors.bad_date: The date must be today or earlier (within the last year).
apiErrors.invoice_mismatch: That bill does not belong to this shop, or it was cancelled.

orders.title: Orders
orders.billAllAsk: Generate {{count}} bills now? Each gets the next invoice number. Check the quantities first.
orders.billAllPartial: {{done}} bills generated. {{failed}} could not be made: open them to see why.
orders.refreshed: Updates by itself when new orders arrive.
orders.badQty: Enter a number above 0, up to 3 decimals.
orders.subtotalNote: The bill adds GST and rounds off.
orders.unsaved: Save your changes before making the bill.
orders.nothingLeft: Keep at least one item, or the bill cannot be made.
orders.notEditable: Quantities can only be changed before the bill is made.

bill.title: Bill
bill.missingGstin: Your company GSTIN is not filled in. Add it in Settings before you print bills.
bill.cancelAsk: Cancel bill {{no}}? The number is not used again. The order goes back to "New" so you can fix it and make a new bill.
bill.cancelled: Bill cancelled. The order is back in the new list.
bill.deliveredLocked: Delivered orders cannot have their bill cancelled.

bills.title: Bills
bills.empty: No bills on this day yet. Generate bills from the Orders screen.
bills.makeNew: Make PDF of only the {{count}} new bills
bills.makeAgain: Make PDF of all {{count}} bills again
bills.allInPdf: Every bill is already in a saved PDF.
bills.newAfterPdf: {{count}} bills were made after the last PDF.
bills.made: PDF version {{version}} is ready and saved ({{count}} bills).
bills.printHint: Two bills per A4 page. Print it, cut along the dashed line, and hand each bill to the delivery person.
bills.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be made. Please try again.

pay.title: Balances
pay.badAmount: Enter an amount above 0, with at most 2 decimals.
pay.removeAsk: Remove this ₹{{amount}} payment? It is deleted and the balance goes back up. The reason is kept in the audit log.
